7.habitat: Montane grassland and cliff faces above 1,200 m.

8.description: Large arboreal squirrel, maroon and cream, with a very long tail.
8.habitat: Upper canopy of evergreen and moist deciduous forest.

9.description: Large dark-brown deer; its alarm call is a reliable predator cue.

audio.name: vanraksha-audio-baseline
audio.notes: Acoustic template matching — set AI_AUDIO_WEIGHTS to use a trained spectrogram CNN.

vision.name: vanraksha-vision-baseline
vision.notes: Baseline descriptor classifier — install trained weights and set AI_VISION_WEIGHTS for field-grade accuracy.

/analytics/ai-performance.caveat: Computed over expert-reviewed observations only; it is review-conditional performance rather than held-out test accuracy.

/analytics/diversity.caveat: Indices are computed on detection counts, not on individuals, and are only comparable between windows with similar sampling effort.

/analytics/geographic.disclaimer: Values are observation/detection counts from opportunistic and fixed-sensor sampling. They are not population estimates.

/analytics/overview.disclaimer: Values are observation/detection counts from opportunistic and fixed-sensor sampling. They are not population estimates.

/analytics/seasonal.disclaimer: Values are observation/detection counts from opportunistic and fixed-sensor sampling. They are not population estimates.

/analytics/trends.disclaimer: Values are observation/detection counts from opportunistic and fixed-sensor sampling. They are not population estimates.

datasets.synthetic: Seeded reference benchmark. Reproducible anywhere; establishes the relative ordering of the variants, not field accuracy.
datasets.verified: Expert-verified observations from this deployment. The only mode whose numbers describe real performance.

variants.image_audio_context: Both, plus a time-of-day and zone prior
